long_description:
Hello Dallas!

ZN Fashions brings you a vibrant Pakistani and Indian clothing and jewelry Ramadan exhibition! Celebrate the spirit of Ramadan by exploring a rich collection of traditional and contemporary attire, featuring intricate embroidery, luxurious fabrics, and stunning designs.

Discover exquisite jewelry pieces that beautifully complement your festive looks, from elegant necklaces to statement earrings.

Bring your family and friends to immerse yourselves in the beauty and diversity of South Asian fashion this Ramadan. Don't miss this chance to elevate your style for the holy month!

​Event Details:

​Dates: Sunday, February 21, 2027

Time: 11am - 7pm​

Location: Crystal Banquet 

6300 Independence Pkwy, Plano, TX 75023

*** FREE ADMISSION AND FREE PARKING ***

For stall booking register yourself at www.znfashions.com/register

For exhibition information, call at 630-776-9407 or send email to aXNyYXIgfCB6bmZhc2hpb25zICEgY29t.
